title: OncoCohortSelect 0.1.0
text: First version. Endpoint() defines binary time--event endpoints; number endpoints can used. PosteriorProb() BenefitRisk() compute posterior benefit-risk score Chakraborty et al. (2026) beta-binomial models rates exponential models gamma priors survival probabilities hazard ratios, target values relative reference cohort, admissibility cutoffs weights. WinStat() computes net treatment benefit, win ratio win odds prioritized endpoints scoring rule Gehan, standard errors first-order H-decomposition confidence intervals. SimCohorts() simulates cohorts correlated progression-free survival, overall survival response (CorOncoEndpoints) independent adverse event; SimSelection(), SelectionOC() CalibrateThreshold() evaluate selection rules simulation.
